**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Kubient agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment or volume restriction on AP:

- **§1 (Services)** — Services are engaged per-Exhibit on a specific-engagement basis, and the arrangement is expressly non-exclusive, with AP free to offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties.
- **§5 (Fees and Payment)** — Pure revenue-share on revenue actually generated; AP pays no subscription or committed fee, and there is no shortfall, true-up or take-or-pay mechanic.
- Term searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "volume" and "purchase" surfaced only unrelated text: the Winning Bid Price floor that AP itself sets (p0014), the §13 disclaimer that no minimum revenue is guaranteed (p0062), and the material-breach "commits" reference (p0016).

This sits at the **preferred position** (no minimum commitment; fees for usage/ordered services only). Noted in the rationale but not flagged: §4(a) prevents convenience termination during the one-year Initial Term — but with no committed spend, that lock-in creates no take-or-pay exposure under this rule (and term/termination flexibility is properly addressed under the termination rule, not double-flagged here).
